decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The extractor flue hereby approved shall not be operated outside the hours of 10.00am - 11.00pm.

Condition : 4 - Anti-vibration mountings and a three-stage filtration system, comprising grease, pre-filter and carbon absorption stages should be incorporated in the system and should be regularly maintained.

Condition : 5 - The extractor flue hereby approved shall not be operated until details of a scheme to control the emission of noise from the extract fan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - Before the extractor flue hereby approved is activated it shall be painted a dark matt colour to be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: The retention of a kitchen extraction duct to the side and rear elevations of the restaurant premises.
